english.note: Use this for a scheduled appointment with a doctor, professional, or service provider rather than an informal meeting.
Use this when the consultation sense focuses on the scheduled appointment rather than the advice session itself.

examples.english: I made an appointment to see the dentist next week.
examples.traditional: 我預約咗下星期睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 jyu6 joek3 zo2 haa6 sing1 kei4 tai2 ngaa4 ji1

examples.english: I’ve already made an appointment for a consultation with the dentist next week.
examples.traditional: 我已經打電話預約下星期睇牙醫。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 daa2 din6 waa2 jyu6 joek3 haa6 sing1 kei4 tai2 ngaa4 ji1
